description: The bar chart illustrates accuracy results (in percent) for two benchmarks, MMAU and MMAR, across three model categories. The horizontal axis contains the model names in left-to-right order: “Qwen2-Audio-Instruct,” “Audio-Reasoner,” and “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” with one grouped pair of bars per model. The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick marks at regular 10-point intervals. For each model, the MMAU bar is shown in blue and the MMAR bar is shown in purple, as indicated by the legend in the upper-left. For “Qwen2-Audio-Instruct,” the blue MMAU bar is approximately 49% and the purple MMAR bar is approximately 30%. For “Audio-Reasoner,” the blue MMAU bar is approximately 61% and the purple MMAR bar is approximately 36%. For “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” the blue MMAU bar is approximately 65% and the purple MMAR bar is approximately 56%. The bars are grouped side-by-side within each model category (not stacked), there are no visible annotations or special highlighting on individual bars, and the category order does not appear to be explicitly sorted by value.
